🔄 Content Update (Published: November 9, 2026 / Previously posted: August 8, 2026)
Main change: Public facility donation boxes closed on October 27, collecting ¥96,422. Donations are still accepted at the main donation box by the front entrance of City Hall.

From August 10 to October 27, 2026, donation boxes placed at public facilities throughout Hanno collected a total of ¥96,422 for relief from the Kumamoto Earthquake disaster. Donations are forwarded through the Japanese Red Cross Society to the prefectural disaster relief committees in affected areas, with 100% going toward support for disaster victims.

The donation boxes at public facilities have now closed, but City Hall's main front entrance information desk continues to accept donations. If you need a receipt, contact the Community Welfare Division (Window 11) on the 1st floor of the City Hall main building.

Thank you for your generous support.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/somubu/bosaikikikanri/bosai/14152.html
